title: Changelog - July 2021
content:
## Changelog - July 2021


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000093714

New Features:

- We implemented an updated in order to display the number of profile views for each member below the Actions Dropdown on the Search Members page in the Admin.  This functionality is available when the "Member Profile Analytics" Add-On is active on the site and the member's Membership Plan has this functionality enabled.

- We added the ability to upload .jfif, .woff, .woff2 and eot files using the Media Manager in the Admin.

- We created a new set of homepage widgets that can be used to display additional sections of custom content powered by the Froala WYSIWYG. To use this new feature, navigate to the Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >> Homepage tab >> Select Content to Display.

- We created a new option for the "Display Additional Information" dropdown when editing the recent member widget settings called "Display Short Description". When this option is selected, the system will display the member "Short Description" data in the Recent Members and Featured Members homepage widgets.

Enhancements / Fixes:

- We implemented an update in order to hide the hard-coded parenthesis in the "Website - Lead Form - Get Matched" form if the Text Label "Required Label" is empty.

- We removed a duplicate modal alert that displayed when exporting data from the Contacts and Forms Inbox pages in the Admin.

- We fixed an issue which was causing the Google Sitemap Generator Add-On to include URLs for the "Write A Review" page for a member even when the member had the Reviews feature disabled for their Membership Plan.

- We fixed a issue which was causing the signup box on the homepage to overlap with the Hero Divider module when the "Require User Consent To Store Data (GDPR)" setting was enabled in some cases.

- We updated the SQL queries required to load the homepage of sites and to load forms on pages to further increase loading speeds.

- We fixed an issue which was causing the system to display a random header menu after selecting the "Hide Menu" option in the "Public Header Menu" Design Setting.

- We fixed an issue which was causing erroneous data to display for custom checkbox fields on member profile pages in some cases.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing Admins from moving members between Membership Plans when using the bulk actions on the Search Members page in the Admin.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from displaying the Search Members page in the Admin when the " Enable Sales Rep Field in Edit Members Form" Advanced Setting was enabled in some cases.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the Form Manager from saving a field when the name of the field was pasted from the clipboard and the "Type of Field" was set as "Section Title" in some cases.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from displaying results in the correct order on post search results pages when using the Grid View in some cases.

- We fixed an issue which was causing the system to duplicate the United Kingdom country dropdown options when editing a member's billing address.

- We added Stripe payment gateway support for zero-decimal currencies.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from completing paid signups when using the Easy Coupons Code and Free Trial Period Add-Ons simultaneously in some cases.

- We removed a section of legacy code which was causing the system to redirect to a member location search when a user searches for a 5-digit number as a keyword.

- We updated the Member Dashboard sidebar in order to display the profile image even if the member does not have a name or company name saved.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from displaying Vimeo video thumbnails in the streaming videos homepage widget in some cases.

- We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to use the location search on the Global Website Search results page in some cases.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing users from purchasing leads in some cases.

- We fixed an issue which was causing the Form Manager to get stuck on the "Processing" message when trying to save a form in some cases.

- We improved the logic of the Member Profile Analytics Add-On to more accurately track the profile views on member profile pages.

- We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to display the dropdown values on post search modules, causing the system to display both the values and variable names in some cases.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from displaying the member CV file after replacing the file in the Member Dashboard in some cases.

- We updated the Froala WYSIWYG in order to allow the "allow" attribute in HTML elements.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from loading the Smart List page in the Admin in some cases.

- We updated the Media Manager in the Admin to improve its loading speed.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from displaying the Page Options tab when editing the Homepage in the Web Page Builder in the Admin.

- We fixed an issue which was causing the system to redirect to the Form Manager page after deleting a new form field when editing a form in the Admin.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from respecting the Members Only Restriction settings on the Global Website Search results page in some cases.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from displaying the Photo Albums Ad widget on Multi-Photo Post Type details pages in some cases.

- The search module dropdown fields on search result pages are now compatible with the Theme Color sets.

- We implemented an update in order to display a system error message when visiting a member signup form (/checkout pages) until recaptcha credentials have been set up for the site.

- We updated the Transaction History page in the Admin so multiple Billing Cycles can be selected simultaneously when searching for transactions.

- We fixed an issue which was affecting the display of values in dropdown fields in post and homepage search modules, causing the system to display both the values and variable names in some cases.

- We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to display the dropdown values in the Website - Lead Form - Get Matched form , causing the system to display both the values and variable names in some cases.

- We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from displaying memebrs' Sub Categories on the Recent Members and Featured Members homepage widgets in some cases.

- In all, over 60 feature enhancements and software updates were released this month.
